test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Mechanic Diesel) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Match the following designations of sheets with their respective trimmed sizes in length and breadth.

Designation Trimmed Size

A) A0 P) 297 x 420

B) A1 Q) 420 × 594

C) A2 R) 594 x 841

D) A3 S) 841 x 1189
solution:
The correct answer is __Option 2**(A-S; B-R; C-Q; D-P)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A0__ has the trimmed size of 841 x 1189 (S).
 
• __A1__ has the trimmed size of 594 x 841 (R).
 
• __A2__ has the trimmed size of 420 x 594 (Q).
 
• __A3__ has the trimmed size of 297 x 420 (P).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Trimmed Sizes:**
 
 
• The trimmed sizes of A-series paper sheets are defined by ISO 216.
 
• Each smaller sheet size is obtained by folding the larger size parallel to its shorter edge.
 
 
 
• **ISO Standard:**
 
 
• The A-series paper sizes are based on a constant width-to-length ratio of 1:√2.
 
• This ratio ensures that when a sheet is folded in half, the halves also have the same proportions.
